_README: Regression fixtures for the validation engine. Deterministic fixtures (kind=cutplan) are unit-tested by pipeline/test_validation.py every change. Vision fixtures (kind=still|clip) are checked on-demand by validate_fixtures.py (costs a little, non-deterministic). 'asset' is a repo-relative path; null = asset to be (re)captured.

cutplan_slowzoom_bad.note: Single slow push-in (the over-correction) — must fail the viral check.

cutplan_richtext_bad.note: Rich subject_block injected (blood/lamplight) — seeds Kling hallucination.

cutplan_cropcut_clean_good.note: Fixed plan: viral crop-cuts + camera-only anti-invention prompt.

still_velazquez_hero_good.note: Strong Velazquez-style crucifixion hero — period, reverent, anatomy sound.

still_garbled_titulus_0701_bad.note: Full composition reveals a garbled-text titulus (AANEI/SOALFCE) — banned text. (Slated for re-render.)

still_modern_crowd_0706_bad.note: Original modern-faced crowd (07 scene 06 v1) was overwritten by the period-fix re-render; recapture the next time a modern-look defect appears.

clip_lava_13_textplan_bad.note: The #07-13 clip animated from the old text cut-plan poured 'lava' from a lamplit door (invented motion). Overwritten by the camera-only re-animation; recapture next frozen-violation.

clip_hero_14_good.note: The living-water hero clip — crop-cut camera only, nothing in the painting moves.
